signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

Dear Sir / Madam,

We are Machine Equipment Joint Stock Company., With Head Office in 17th Floor, 23 Ha, Cau Giay, Hanoi, Vietnam.

In all over Vietnam, we are specialized in importing and distributing Machine Tools, Control & Measuring Instruments. We are very well-connected to Government and Private enterprises' projects in our country.

After we visit your website and technical documents we are interested in your product ranges and we would like to have more information about your products.

At this time, we are looking for the products as attached.
Please send us the quotation for this products included Standard accessories and replacement accessories and catalog.

Of course, If you have any question, please feel free to let us know, we are happy to answer any questions you might have.

We are appreciating a short reply to understand if this is of interest to you.

We are looking forward to hearing from you soon!

All the best and kind regards,
